source.name: Xyce Regression Suite primitive-device tests (SPICE3 translations of the ngspice-rejected fixtures)
source.redistributionDecision: Allowed under GPL-3.0-or-later as modified versions. The upstream copyright and licence notice and the complete GPLv3 text are retained byte-for-byte; every translated deck states the upstream file, the modifications and their date in its header.
source.mechanicalAdaptation: Purely syntactic Xyce -> SPICE3 translation by the deterministic translator, applied to the verbatim, hash-pinned originals in benchmarks/corpus/xyce (which stay unchanged). Rules: tran-zero-tstep: Xyce `.tran 0 TSTOP [TSTART [TMAX]]` (zero print step: output at every accepted step) -> `.tran TSTEP TSTOP ...` with TSTEP = (TSTOP - TSTART)/50. SPICE3/ngspice require TSTEP > 0. ngspice caps its default maximum step at MIN(TSTEP, (TSTOP - TSTART)/50) and its first step at MIN(TSTOP/100, TSTEP)/10, so (TSTOP - TSTART)/50 is the smallest TSTEP whose ngspice output is identical to any larger TSTEP (ngspice-47 raw data verified byte-identical for 1x, 10x and 50x on the translated decks, different at 0.5x); with a rawfile ngspice writes every accepted step, like Xyce with a zero print step. timeint-tolerances-removed: Xyce `.options timeint` lines whose fields are only RELTOL, ABSTOL and METHOD=7/TRAP are commented out. TIMEINT is a Xyce option package (time-integrator tolerances that are separate from the Newton tolerances); SPICE3 has no equivalent package, and METHOD=7 is trapezoidal, the SPICE3 default. Both engines therefore run at their default tolerances. Any other TIMEINT field (e.g. NEWLTE) selects a Xyce-only algorithm and makes the fixture unsupported-translation. step-source-to-nested-dc: Xyce `.step <V|I source> START STOP STEP` in a deck with exactly one single-source `.dc` sweep -> the second (outer) sweep of a SPICE3 nested `.dc`. Xyce runs the inner `.dc` once per stepped source value, which is the SPICE3 nested-sweep order; Xyce_Regression itself uses this form in NJFET_DC/njfet-2109.cir. Other `.step` forms are unsupported. capacitor-ic-to-dot-ic: Capacitor instance `IC=V` on a capacitor with one terminal at ground, in a `.tran` without UIC -> the instance line is kept and `.ic v(<node>)=V` is added. Xyce always applies device initial conditions, enforcing them in the transient operating point exactly like `.IC` (Xyce 6.10 release notes, bug 1040-SON; xyce-users "Xyce always uses initial conditions you specify, with or without UIC"); SPICE3 ignores instance IC= without UIC but enforces `.ic` node voltages in the operating point. A capacitor with neither terminal grounded, or an inductor IC=, has no SPICE3 node-voltage equivalent and is unsupported. print-brace-expressions: Brace expressions in `.print` (Xyce-only syntax) are replaced by the output variables (V(...)/I(...)) they reference, without duplicates. The compared signals are the engines' full node-voltage/branch-current vectors, which already contain those variables; ngspice ignores `.print` when a rawfile is written. Every changed line is kept as a comment in the translated deck. Fixtures with a construct that has no exact SPICE3 equivalent are marked unsupported-translation and not translated.

changes: c1 IC=1 -> added `.ic v(1)=1` (Xyce applies device IC= without UIC)
removed Xyce `.options timeint reltol=1e-6 abstol=1e-6` (no SPICE3 TIMEINT package; both engines use default tolerances)

reasons: Xyce `.options timeint newlte=2` selects a Xyce time-integrator algorithm with no SPICE3 equivalent.

changes: removed Xyce `.options timeint reltol=1.0e-4 abstol=1e-4 method=7` (no SPICE3 TIMEINT package; both engines use default tolerances)

reasons: Diode model DZR is Xyce LEVEL=2 (PSpice-compatible diode equations). SPICE3 has no level-2 diode (ngspice-47: "Diode model level 2 is not supported"), and substituting the level-1 diode would change the model equations.
Xyce `.step TEMP list -55 25 72`: SPICE3 batch mode has no parameter-stepping command, and this form is not a single source stepped over a single-source .dc sweep.

original.ngspiceRejection: ngspice reports the fixture's PSpice level-2 diode model unsupported.

reasons: Diode model DFOR is Xyce LEVEL=2 (PSpice-compatible diode equations). SPICE3 has no level-2 diode (ngspice-47: "Diode model level 2 is not supported"), and substituting the level-1 diode would change the model equations.
Xyce `.options DEVICE` package: no translation rule is implemented.

changes: removed Xyce `.options timeint reltol=1.0e-4` (no SPICE3 TIMEINT package; both engines use default tolerances)
.print brace expressions -> referenced output variables (I(VMON) V(3))

original.ngspiceRejection: Batch ngspice rejects the fixture's Xyce .STEP command.

changes: `.Step Vgs 0 -1.875 -0.625` -> outer sweep of the nested .dc
